title: Demo app UI labels: buttons, headings and fields
acceptanceCriteria: Login page shows the heading 'Login' and a button with the text 'Sign in'
Login page shows input fields labelled 'Email' and 'Password'
After signing in with valid credentials the page shows a 'Go to Cart' button
Cart page shows the heading 'Cart (0)' before any item is added
Cart page lists 'Widget A' priced at '$9.99' with an 'Add to cart' button in the same card
